name: list
description: List every toil project toil can see, where each lives, and any that are broken

name: show
description: Print a toil project, and the connection, environment and inputs it gives each area

name: check
description: Check a toil project locally: its schema, its connections and hosts, its remotes. Contacts no service.

name: context
description: Show which toil project a folder resolves to, and why

name: migrate
description: Move your toil projects from the old ~/.toil/dossiers folder to ~/.toil/projects (asks for a yes, or pass --yes)

name: brief
description: Brief one toil project by code: what needs a person, under one reason each, and what to do first, from OWI records you pass (local only)

name: analyze show
description: Show how Analyze briefs a toil project: its reader, its lenses in order with their thresholds, and its focus

name: analyze prompt
description: Print the Analyze prompt for a toil project, for an agent with toil to run

name: pivot
description: Pivot a toil project's work items: one measure, split by one dimension, across time or another, from OWI records you pass (local only)

name: view set
description: Save a pivot as a named view in a toil project, so everyone opens the same chart

name: view show
description: Show one saved view of a toil project, and the pivot it runs

name: view list
description: List a toil project's saved views

name: view remove
description: Delete one saved view from a toil project

name: init
description: Create a toil project in your own folder (~/.toil/projects), or with --shared in a repository for the team

name: add-repo
description: Add a repository to a toil project, by its folder or its remote URL

name: link
description: Attach an area to a toil project: which connection it uses, and its keys

name: env
description: Add an environment's resources for an area to a toil project

name: field
description: Name one of an area's fields in a toil project, so prompts use the name

name: person
description: Add someone to a toil project's people, with the identity each system knows them by

name: people suggest
description: Suggest which accounts in work items and pull requests are the toil project's people, from OWI records you pass (local only)

name: people save
description: Save a toil project's people into a repository's .toil/projects, so the mapping is checked in with the code

name: wip-limit
description: Set how many items one person may have in progress at once

name: analyze set
description: Tune how Analyze briefs a toil project: its goal, reader, lenses, and what to watch for or leave out

name: describe
description: Rename one of your own toil projects, or change its description

name: export
description: Write a toil project for sharing: into a repository's .toil/projects, or to one file

name: import
description: Copy a toil project into your own folder, adopting its bindings

name: unlink
description: Remove an area's section from a toil project, or one environment's

name: remove
description: Delete one of your own toil projects

name: archive
description: Archive one of your own toil projects: hidden from lists, kept on disk, reversible

name: unarchive
description: Bring an archived toil project back

name: diagram check
description: Check an architecture diagram's model exactly as save would, without keeping it (local only)

name: diagram save
description: Keep a toil project's architecture diagram in your own folder (~/.toil/diagrams)

name: diagram show
description: Show a toil project's stored architecture diagram, or one of its views as computed (local only)

name: diagram list
description: List the architecture diagrams kept in your own folder (local only)

name: diagram remove
description: Delete a toil project's stored architecture diagram

name: onboard
description: Set up this repo: match each area of its toil project to your connections, add the ones you lack, then check it and test each

name: classify set
description: Set a toil project's classification: its scheme, and where each tracker keeps the category
